Emily is also a non-resident fellow at CSIS and was previously part of the team that built the commerce department's new supply chain center in 2024 and 2025. Emily moved to Europe several months ago and she and I discuss what economic security actually is, whether Europe can and should wean itself off American technology due to geopolitical risks, whether the US should be more focused on promoting our own economic and technological leverage, and how China thinks about economic statecraftraft.
